pages.text: Nether or netherrack ores make reddish netherrack rocks. End or end-stone ores make pale End stone rocks. Deepslate ores make darker rocks.$(br2)The ore interior is tinted separately, so quartz stays pale inside a red host instead of becoming a red ore fleck.

pages.title: How a Host Is Chosen
pages.text: Auram checks whole words in the source ore ID, then its particle texture path. For example, $(thing)end_draconium_ore$() selects End stone, while $(thing)enderium_ore$() alone does not.$(br2)The client uses the active host textures with Auram’s rock silhouette. Resource reloads rebuild these surfaces and their color caches.
